event: Hoover ancestors (Swiss-German) land in Pennsylvania
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Jesse Hoover, age 8, migrates with family from Miami County, Ohio, to West Branch, Iowa
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Minthorn family (incl. Hulda, 11) crosses from Norwich, Ontario, to a farm near West Branch
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Grant's "President's Quaker Policy" outsources Plains Indian administration to the Friends
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Jesse Hoover marries Hulda Minthorn (Methodist pastor A. M. Smith officiates)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Herbert Clark Hoover born, West Branch (date is an estimate; he switched between 10 and 11)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover conceived during the Panic of 1873 (~14% unemployment, 18,000 business failures over two years)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Croup nearly kills 2-year-old Herbert; uncle Dr. Henry John Minthorn revives him
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Jesse sells blacksmith business for $1,000, opens farm-implement store (sells barbed wire)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Jesse Hoover dies, age 34
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hulda given the "gift of ministry"
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hulda Hoover dies, age 35 (pneumonia complicated by typhoid)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Lawrie Tatum appointed guardian; children's joint estate ~ $2,000
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover sent by emigrant train to Newberg, Oregon ($33 ticket from his estate share; two dimes in pocket)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Minthorn becomes partner/president of Oregon Land Company, Salem; firm raised $20,000
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover (14+) office boy at Oregon Land Co., $20/month, later $35
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Oregon Land Co. capital stock reaches $200,000
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover sits Stanford entrance exams in Portland, administered by Joseph Swain; "came up short"
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover leaves Salem for San Francisco
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Classes begin at Stanford; Hoover in first room assignment at Encina Hall
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover becomes office assistant to John Casper Branner, $25/month
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Assistant to USGS geologist Waldemar Lindgren in the Sierra
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Lou Henry, freshman from Monterey, enters Branner's geology program; meets Hoover in geology lab
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Hoover graduates, age 20, AB in geology
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: USGS job ($1,200/yr) lost to appropriation cuts (Panic of 1893)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Mucker at Reward Mine (Nevada City/Grass Valley, Calif.), $2/day; then Mayflower Mine graveyard shift $2.50/day
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Has saved $100; moves to Oakland (Twelfth St.) with Theodore and May
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Joins Louis Janin, San Francisco; tied to North Star Mining Co. defense in $825,000 suit by Carson City Gold & Silver Co.
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Mine scout in the Southwest for Janin
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Bewick, Moreing & Co. (London) cables SF for American engineers for W. Australia; $5,000/yr; minimum age 35; Hoover is 22
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Leaves San Francisco; stops in West Branch; London
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Leaves London by mail train to Brindisi; SS *Victoria* via Suez
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Arrives Albany, W. Australia (5 days' smallpox quarantine), then Perth, Coolgardie
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Journeys north to Lawlers; first sees Sons of Gwalia lease
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Examines Sons of Gwalia; recommends purchase ("half a million dollars in profit" in ore in sight)
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Sons of Gwalia under Hoover produces 5,667 oz gold; London committed a half million in cash
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Raise to $10,000/yr; promoted junior partner ("pardner")
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Sets off 400 lb of dynamite at a remote mine to celebrate
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Plot against MD Ernest Williams discovered; Williams calls for dismissal; Moreing, back from China, sends Hoover to Tientsin
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)

event: Sons of Gwalia finally closes
source: Kenneth Whyte, Hoover: An Extraordinary Life in Extraordinary Times (New York: Knopf, 2017)
